exposure: outpatient cervical ripening with oral misoprostol
outpatient use of misoprostol for cervical ripening
outcome: time from inpatient admission to delivery
duration and maximum rate of oxytocin administered
finding: Outpatient use of misoprostol for cervical ripening under a study protocol was associated with reduced inpatient time from admission to delivery compared with inpatient misoprostol, but there was a higher rate of chorioamnionitis among outpatients under the study protocol compared with inpatients at all hospitals.
mod_finding: There was no difference in cesarean delivery rates between groups receiving outpatient vs. inpatient misoprostol.
